hook: This plane can dump 3,000 gallons on a wildfire in under 5 seconds.
narration: This plane can dump three thousand gallons of fire retardant in under five seconds.
It was flying over the Hughes Fire in Castaic, California, on January 22, 2025.
A California Air National Guard crew was at the controls.
The firefighting kit, called MAFFS, slides into a regular military C-130 and turns it into an air tanker.
One drop can cover a strip a quarter mile long and one hundred feet wide.
Once it is empty, it lands and can be refilled in under twelve minutes.
outcome: All eight MAFFS C-130s on the mission were launched to help CAL FIRE fight the Southern California fires.
